caption: The drawing depicts two wooden jointed dolls positioned side by side against a plain, off-white background. Both dolls feature cylindrical limbs and rounded heads with painted facial features. The larger doll, on the right, has a light beige face with pink cheeks, red lips, and faint blue eyes, with short dark hair painted onto the upper part of its head. Its torso and limbs are colored in shades of brown and tan, resembling a wooden texture, and it wears what appears to be a simple styled garment also painted in brown. The legs are elongated and end in dark, triangular shapes representing shoes. The smaller doll, on the left, has similar features—a painted face with a neutral expression, short dark hair, and brown/tan coloring on the torso and upper limbs to mimic wood. Its legs and lower arms are shaded light beige, and its toes are slightly pointed. Both figures are rendered with visible lines indicating jointed segments at shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees, suggesting articulated construction. The dolls are centrally placed, oriented upright, with the larger doll slightly higher and to the right of the smaller one. There is no defined background or setting other than the plain, lightly textured off-white backdrop.
title: Jointed Wooden Dolls
